sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN strpos((p.traits ->> $2::text), $3::text) > 0 END), false) AND p.traits @> $4::jsonb AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN (p.traits ->> $2::text) = ANY($5::text[]) END), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN (p.traits ->> $2::text) <> $6::text END), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN (p.traits ->> $2::text) <> ALL($7::text[]) END), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $2::text)) = 'string' THEN left((p.traits ->> $2::text), char_length($8::text)) = $8::text END), false)))
